jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture . Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring . Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Must have

• Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

• GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

• High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

• Linux systems depth . Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

• Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

• HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

• Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

• Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

• A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

• Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

• Location . Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

• Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

• VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

• Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

• Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

• Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

• Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Cosmic AC è la piattaforma di calcolo e inferenza gestita della GPU di Tether Data: contenitori GPU, endpoint di inferenza gestiti e osservanza della piattaforma, consegnati come pacchetto self-hosted su Kubernetes, con un piano di controllo scritto in JavaScript. La piattaforma si sta espandendo dall'orchestrazione di carichi di lavoro su un cluster gestito per possedere l'intero stack sull'infrastruttura GPU bare-metal: uno strato di programmazione Slurm gestito per la ricerca interna e le squadre di modellazione prima, e il nostro piano di controllo Kubernetes per la tenancy inferenza dopo che.

Il Lead Tecnico possiede l'architettura e la consegna di tale stack e conduce il team di ingegneria costruendolo: circa dodici ingegneri attraverso backend, frontend, DevOps, QA e documentazione, distribuiti in Europa e India. Il ruolo segnala al Senior Technical Product Manager di Cosmic AC, che possiede la portata, il sequenziamento e gli impegni dei partner; il Technical Lead possiede l'architettura, l'implementazione e i piani di consegna, la linea-gestisce gli ingegneri, ed è l'interfaccia tecnica primaria ai nostri partner infrastrutturali.

Questo è un ruolo di leadership delle infrastrutture pratico con una finestra di consegna fissa nei suoi primi sei mesi. Non è un ruolo di ricerca, non un puro Kubernetes SRE ruolo, e non un ruolo di gestione solo.

responsabilità

Architettura . Possedere la piattaforma architettura fine alla fine: proposte di architettura, disegni di alto livello e basso livello, guidato attraverso la revisione e mantenuto corrente come la linea di base.

Leader del team. Guidare e gestire una squadra distribuita attraverso backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA e documentazione: standard di ingegneria, codice e recensione di progettazione, cancelli di rilascio, one-to-ones, crescita e input delle prestazioni.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Progettazione, costruzione e gestione di un servizio Slurm gestito per gli utenti di ricerca: controllore e contabilità, partizioni e nodi di login, nodo onboarding e accettazione, driver e CUDA baseline e aggiornamenti, stalled-job e nodo-health rilevamento, drenaggio e autohealing, visibilità di storage, identità e isolamento.

Kubernetes controllo aereo e abilitazione GPU. Stivali a grappolo e ciclo di vita su metallo nudo fornito da partner, NVIDIA GPU Operator e Network Operator, isolamento GPU basato sulle VM (KubeVirt e VFIO), e operazioni di day-2: aggiornamenti, backup e ripristino, sostituzione nodo.

Inferenza gestita in scala. Serve architettura, multi-GPU e multi-nodo parallelismo, autoscaling, richiesta routing e affidabilità endpoint; capacità confidenziale-compute-capable per carichi di lavoro sensibili.

Osservabilità e operazioni. Metriche, logging, allerta e SLOs attraverso il piano di controllo, la flotta GPU e i livelli di applicazione; risposta incidente e revisione post-incidente; un modello on-call un piccolo team può sostenere.

Partner e fornitori. Interfaccia tecnica primaria ai partner e ai fornitori di infrastrutture: trasformare i requisiti in specifiche scritte e test di accettazione, eseguire escalations alla chiusura, e fornire input tecnici alla pianificazione delle capacità e all'assistenza hardware.

Consumatori interni. Lavorare direttamente con team di ricerca, modellazione e prodotto per tradurre i loro carichi di lavoro in requisiti della piattaforma, e capacità di broker quando è breve.

Assunzione. Completare il team della piattaforma e impostare la barra tecnica per gli ingegneri che si uniscono.

Devo

• Esperienza. Otto o più anni di ingegneria hands-on, tra cui almeno tre squadre leader che costruiscono e gestiscono piattaforme infrastrutturali altre squadre dipendono. Corso di laurea o master in informatica o ingegneria, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• Slurm a scale, mani su. Ha eseguito slurmctld e slurmdbd per utenti reali: partizioni, QoS e priorità, contabilità, prolog ed epilog, nodo scripting sanitario, aggiornamenti con lavori sul sistema. Idealmente ha gestito un cluster di formazione HPC o GPU per una popolazione di ricerca.

• Funzionamento della flotta GPU su metallo nudo. Driver NVIDIA e ciclo di vita CUDA, Fabric Manager e NVSwitch comportamento sui sistemi SXM, salute e utilizzo basati su DCGM, MIG, nodo burn-in e accettazione.

• Interconnessioni ad alte prestazioni. Configurazione di tessuto e subnet InfiniBand, RDMA, SR-IOV, e diagnosticare problemi di prestazioni NCCL multi-nodo.

• Profondità dei sistemi Linux . Moduli e driver Kernel, passthrough PCIe e vfio-pci, cgroups e namespaces, sintonizzazione delle prestazioni per carichi di lavoro calcolati-pesanti.

• Funzionamento Kubernetes di produzione, non solo distribuzione: piano di controllo, aggiornamenti, CNI e CSI, operatori e controller personalizzati, progettazione multi-tenancy.

• storage HPC e movimento dati. Filesystem condivisi (VAST, Lustre, NFS), nodo-local NVMe caching, distribuendo pesi e set di grandi modelli in molti nodi.

• Osservabilità e operazioni. Prometeo, Grafana e Loki o equivalenti, SLO, risposta incidente e revisione post-incidente.

• Fluency di lavoro in JavaScript e Node.js sufficienti per rivedere un piano di controllo, CLI e servizi di lavoratori con autorità e prendere decisioni di architettura su di loro. Non è un requisito di sviluppo.

• Una piattaforma spedita con utenti reali. Un IaaS multi-tenant o PaaS, o un servizio di elaborazione della ricerca: isolamento delle risorse, quote, misurazione dell'utilizzo e superfici API e CLI orientate all'utente.

• Leadership che rimane nel codice. Gestione delle persone attraverso fusi orari, revisione cross-track, decisioni di architettura scritta con alternative registrate, e la capacità di dire a un partner o un executive no con motivi.

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese. La maggior parte del lavoro di partner e leadership avviene per iscritto.

• Location . Completamente a distanza, con sede tra UTC e UTC+5:30 così la giornata di lavoro si sovrappone sia in Europa che in India, dove il team e i suoi partner lavorano. Viaggi occasionali a siti partner e eventi di squadra.

Desiderabile

• Operatori di liquami su Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) o pianificatori nativi Kubernetes (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Pile di servizio moderne (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): strategie di parallelismo, compromessi di quantizzazione, pianificazione della memoria GPU.

• Isolamento di VM e container per la computazione multi-tenant GPU (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU e KVM, Firecracker); elaborazione confidenziale (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA modalità confidenziale-compute).

• API Cluster e kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastruttura come codice e GitOps.

• Tempo sul lato operatore di una nuvola GPU, un centro HPC nazionale o universitario, o un team di piattaforma del laboratorio AI.

• Peer-to-peer o sistemi distribuiti sfondo.

• Esperienza con un fornitore di hardware che provveda ma non opera, e trasformando tale relazione in un contratto scritto con i test di accettazione.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture . Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring . Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Must have

• Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

• GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

• High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

• Linux systems depth . Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

• Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

• HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

• Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

• Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

• A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

• Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

• Location . Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

• Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

• VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

• Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

• Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

• Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

• Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen
Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere innovativen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten -, reservegestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie können Sie digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten speichern, senden und empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet das Vertrauen in jede Transaktion.

Innovation mit Tether
Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite verfügt über den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte von Millionen weltweit verlassen, neben bahnbrechenden Tokenisierungsdiensten für digitale Vermögenswerte.
Aber das ist erst der Anfang:
Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus der Ferne aus allen Ecken der Welt arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Cosmic AC ist die GPU-Compute- und Managed-Inference-Plattform von Tether Data: GPU-Container, Managed-Inference-Endpunkte und Plattform-Beobachtbarkeit, die als selbst gehostetes Paket auf Kubernetes mit einer in JavaScript geschriebenen Steuerungsebene geliefert werden. Die Plattform erweitert sich von der Orchestrierung von Workloads auf einem verwalteten Cluster bis hin zum Besitz des vollständigen Stacks auf der Bare-Metal-GPU-Infrastruktur: eine verwaltete Slurm-Planungsschicht für interne Forschungs- und Modellschulungsteams und unsere eigene Kubernetes-Kontrollebene für die Inferenzmiete danach.

Der Technical Lead ist Eigentümer der Architektur und Lieferung dieses Stacks und leitet das Engineering-Team, das ihn erstellt: etwa zwölf Ingenieure aus den Bereichen Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und Dokumentation, verteilt über Europa und Indien. Die Rolle berichtet an den Senior Technical Product Manager für Cosmic AC, der Umfang, Sequenzierung und Partnerverpflichtungen besitzt; der Technical Lead besitzt Architektur, Implementierungs- und Lieferpläne, leitet die Linie und ist die primäre technische Schnittstelle zu unseren Infrastrukturpartnern.

Dies ist eine praktische Führungsrolle in der Infrastruktur mit einem festen Lieferfenster in den ersten sechs Monaten. Es ist keine Forschungsrolle, keine reine Kubernetes SRE-Rolle und keine reine Managementrolle.

Zuständigkeiten

Architektur. Besitzen Sie die Plattform-Architektur von Ende zu Ende: Architekturvorschläge, High-Level- und Low-Level-Designs, die durch Überprüfung und als Basislinie aktuell gehalten werden.

Teamführung. Führen und leiten Sie ein verteiltes Team über Backend (Node.js), Frontend (React), DevOps, QA und Dokumentation: Engineering-Standards, Code- und Design-Review, Release-Gates, One-to-Ones, Wachstum und Performance-Input.

Bare-Metal-GPU-Planungsschicht. Entwerfen, bauen und betreiben Sie einen verwalteten Slurm-Service für Forschungsbenutzer: Controller und Buchhaltung, Partitionen und Anmeldeknoten, Node-Onboarding und -Akzeptanz, Treiber und CUDA-Baseline und Upgrades, Stillstand und Node-Health-Erkennung, Drain und Autohealing, Speichersichtbarkeit, Identität und Isolation.

Kubernetes Control Plane und GPU Enablement. Eigener Cluster-Bootstrap und -Lebenszyklus auf von Partnern bereitgestelltem Bare Metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator und Network Operator, VM-basierte GPU-Isolation (KubeVirt und VFIO) und Tag-2-Operationen: Upgrades, Backup und Recovery, Node-Ersatz.

Managed Inference im Maßstab. Serving Architektur, Multi-GPU und Multi-Node-Parallelität, Autoscaling, Request Routing und Endpoint-Zuverlässigkeit; vertraulich-rechenfähige Kapazität für sensible Workloads.

Beobachtbarkeit und Operationen. Metriken, Protokollierung, Alarmierung und SLOs über Steuerungsebene, GPU-Flotte und Anwendungsebenen; Reaktion auf Vorfälle und Überprüfung nach einem Vorfall; ein Bereitschaftsmodell, das ein kleines Team unterstützen kann.

Partner und Verkäufer. Primäre technische Schnittstelle zu Infrastrukturpartnern und Anbietern: Anforderungen in schriftliche Spezifikationen und Abnahmetests umwandeln, Eskalationen bis hin zur Schließung durchführen und technischen Input für Kapazitätsplanung und Hardwarebeschaffung bereitstellen.

Interne Verbraucher. Arbeiten Sie direkt mit Research-, Model-Training- und Produktteams zusammen, um ihre Workloads in Plattformanforderungen und Brokerkapazitäten zu übersetzen, wenn sie knapp sind.

Mieten. Vervollständigen Sie das Plattformteam und legen Sie die technische Bar für die Ingenieure fest, die sich ihm anschließen.

Muss haben

• Erfahrung. Acht oder mehr Jahre praktisches Engineering, darunter mindestens drei führende Teams, die Infrastrukturplattformen aufbauen und betreiben, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind. Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder Ingenieurwissenschaften oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• Slurm auf Skala, Hände an. Hat slurmctld und slurmdbd für echte Benutzer ausgeführt: Partitionen, QoS und Priorität, Buchhaltung, Prolog und Epilog, Node Health Scripting, Upgrades mit Jobs auf dem System. Idealerweise hat ein HPC- oder GPU-Trainingscluster für eine Forschungsbevölkerung betrieben.

• GPU-Flottenbetrieb auf blankem Metall. NVIDIA-Treiber und CUDA-Lebenszyklus, Fabric Manager und NVSwitch-Verhalten auf SXM-Systemen, DCGM-basierter Zustand und Nutzung, MIG, Node Burn-In und Akzeptanz.

• Hochleistungs-Verbindungen. InfiniBand Fabric- und Subnetzkonfiguration, RDMA, SR-IOV und Diagnose von NCCL-Leistungsproblemen mit mehreren Knoten.

• Linux-Systeme Tiefe. Kernelmodule und Treiber, PCIe Passthrough und vfio-pci, cgroups und Namespaces, Performance Tuning für rechenintensive Workloads.

• Produktion Kubernetes Betrieb, nicht nur Bereitstellung: Steuerungsebene, Upgrades, CNI und CSI, Betreiber und benutzerdefinierte Controller, Multi-Tenancy-Design.

• HPC-Speicherung und Datenbewegung. Gemeinsame Dateisysteme (VAST, Lustre, NFS), knotenlokales NVMe-Caching, das große Modellgewichte und Datensätze auf viele Knoten verteilt.

• Beobachtbarkeit und Operationen. Prometheus, Grafana und Loki oder Äquivalente, SLOs, Incident Response und Post-Incident Review.

• Die fließende Arbeit in JavaScript und Node.js reicht aus, um eine Kontrollebene, CLI und Worker Services mit Autorität zu überprüfen und Architekturentscheidungen darüber zu treffen. Keine Feature-Entwicklungsanforderung.

• Eine versendete Plattform mit echten Benutzern. Ein Multi-Tenant-IaaS oder PaaS oder ein Research-Computing-Service: Ressourcenisolierung, Quoten, Nutzungsmessung und benutzerseitige API- und CLI-Oberflächen.

• Führung, die im Code bleibt. Personalmanagement über Zeitzonen hinweg, Cross-Track-Überprüfung, schriftliche Architekturentscheidungen mit aufgezeichneten Alternativen und die Fähigkeit, einem Partner oder einer Führungskraft mit Gründen Nein zu sagen.

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch. Die meisten Partner- und Führungsarbeiten erfolgen schriftlich.

• Standort . Vollständig entfernt, zwischen UTC und UTC + 5:30, so dass sich der Arbeitstag sowohl in Europa als auch in Indien überschneidet, wo das Team und seine Partner arbeiten. Gelegentliche Reisen zu Partnerseiten und Teamevents.

Wünschenswert

• Slurm-Operatoren auf Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) oder Kubernetes-native Scheduler (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Moderne Serving Stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): Parallelitätsstrategien, Quantisierungskompromisse, GPU-Speicherplanung.

• VM- und Container-Isolation für Multi-Tenant-GPU-Compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU und KVM, Firecracker); vertrauliches Rechnen (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA).

• Cluster API und kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-Klasse Autohealing, Infrastruktur als Code und GitOps.

• Zeit auf der Betreiberseite einer GPU-Cloud, eines nationalen oder universitären HPC-Zentrums oder eines Plattformteams eines KI-Labors.

• Peer-to-Peer oder Distributed-Systems Hintergrund.

• Erfahrung mit einem Hardwareanbieter, der Provisionen erbringt, aber nicht arbeitet, und diese Beziehung in einen schriftlichen Vertrag mit Akzeptanztests umwandelt.

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Im zweifelsfall, fühlen sie sich frei, über unsere offizielle website zu erreichen.

Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Cosmic AC est la plate-forme de calcul et d'inférence gérée de Tether Data : conteneurs GPU, paramètres d'inférence gérés et observabilité de la plate-forme, livrés sous forme d'un paquet auto-organisé sur Kubernetes, avec un plan de contrôle écrit en JavaScript. La plate-forme s'étend de l'orchestration des charges de travail sur un cluster géré à la possession de la pile complète sur l'infrastructure GPU nu-métal: une couche de planification de Slurm gérée pour les équipes internes de recherche et de formation de modèles d'abord, et notre propre plan de contrôle Kubernetes pour l'inférence tenancy après cela.

Le responsable technique possède l'architecture et la livraison de cette pile et dirige l'équipe d'ingénierie en la construisant: environ douze ingénieurs à travers backend, frontend, DevOps, QA et documentation, distribués dans toute l'Europe et l'Inde. Le rôle est confié au responsable technique principal des produits pour Cosmic AC, qui possède la portée, le séquençage et les engagements des partenaires; le responsable technique possède l'architecture, les plans de mise en oeuvre et de livraison, gère la ligne des ingénieurs et constitue la principale interface technique avec nos partenaires en infrastructure.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership pratique en matière d'infrastructure, avec un guichet de livraison fixe au cours de ses six premiers mois. Ce n'est pas un rôle de recherche, pas un rôle pur de Kubernetes SRE, et pas un rôle de gestion seulement.

Responsabilités

Architecture . Posséder l'architecture de la plate-forme de bout en bout: les propositions d'architecture, les conceptions de haut niveau et de bas niveau, animées par un examen et maintenues à jour comme base de référence.

Chef d'équipe. Diriger et gérer une équipe répartie sur tout le backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA et documentation: normes d'ingénierie, examen de code et de conception, portes de lancement, données individuelles, croissance et rendement.

Couche de programmation GPU en métal de bare . Concevoir, construire et exploiter un service Slurm géré pour les utilisateurs de la recherche : contrôleur et comptabilité, partitions et nœuds de connexion, embarquement et acceptation des nœuds, pilote et CUDA de base et mises à niveau, travail décroché et détection des nœuds de santé, drain et autoguérison, visibilité de stockage, identité et isolement.

Plan de contrôle Kubernetes et activation GPU. Son propre bootstrap et cycle de vie sur le métal nu fourni par un partenaire, l'opérateur du GPU NVIDIA et l'opérateur du réseau, l'isolation du GPU à base de VM (KubeVirt et VFIO), et les opérations de jour-2 : mises à niveau, sauvegarde et récupération, remplacement des nœuds.

Inférence gérée à l'échelle. L'architecture de service, le parallélisme multi-GPU et multi-noeud, le calibrage automatique, le routage des requêtes et la fiabilité des paramètres; la capacité de calcul confidentiel pour les charges de travail sensibles.

Observabilité et opérations. Les mesures, l'enregistrement, l'alerte et les ALS à travers l'avion de contrôle, la flotte GPU et les niveaux d'application; l'intervention en cas d'incident et l'examen post-incident; un modèle sur appel qu'une petite équipe peut soutenir.

Partenaires et fournisseurs. Interface technique principale avec les partenaires de l'infrastructure et les fournisseurs : transformation des exigences en spécifications écrites et tests d'acceptation, accélération de la fermeture et apport technique à la planification des capacités et à l'approvisionnement en matériel.

Les consommateurs internes. Travailler directement avec des équipes de recherche, de formation de modèles et de produits pour traduire leur charge de travail en exigences de plateforme, et la capacité de courtage quand elle est courte.

Embaucher. Compléter l'équipe de la plateforme et définir la barre technique pour les ingénieurs qui la rejoignent.

Ça doit avoir

• Expérience. Huit ans ou plus d'ingénierie pratique, dont au moins trois équipes dirigeantes qui construisent et exploitent des plates-formes d'infrastructure dont dépendent d'autres équipes. Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou en génie, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• Slurme à l'échelle, mains ouvertes. A exécuté slurmctld et slurmdbd pour les utilisateurs réels: partitions, QoS et priorité, comptabilité, prolog et épilog, script de santé des noeuds, mises à jour avec des tâches sur le système. Idéalement, il a exploité une grappe de formation HPC ou GPU pour une population de chercheurs.

• Opération de flotte GPU sur métal nu. Conducteur NVIDIA et cycle de vie CUDA, Fabric Manager et comportement NVSwitch sur les systèmes SXM, la santé et l'utilisation basées sur DCGM, MIG, burn-in nœud et l'acceptation.

• Interconnexions hautes performances. Configuration de tissu et de sous-réseau InfiniBand, RDMA, SR-IOV, et diagnostic de problèmes de performance multinoeud CCNL.

• Profondeur des systèmes Linux . Modules et pilotes de noyau, PCIe passthrough et vfio-pci, cgroups et namespaces, réglage des performances pour les charges de travail lourdes de calcul.

• Production Kubernetes opération, pas seulement déploiement: avion de contrôle, mises à niveau, CNI et CSI, opérateurs et contrôleurs personnalisés, conception multi-tenance.

• Stockage HPC et mouvement des données. Systèmes de fichiers partagés (VAST, Lustre, NFS), cache NVMe local des nœuds, distribuant de gros poids de modèles et ensembles de données sur de nombreux nœuds.

• Observabilité et opérations. Prométhée, Grafana et Loki ou équivalents, ALS, réponse à l'incident et examen post-incident.

• La fluidité de travail dans JavaScript et Node.js suffit pour examiner un avion de contrôle, CLI et les services aux travailleurs avec autorité et pour prendre des décisions d'architecture sur eux. Pas une exigence de développement de fonctionnalités.

• Une plateforme expédiée avec de vrais utilisateurs. Un IaaS ou PaaS, ou un service informatique de recherche : isolement des ressources, quotas, dosage d'utilisation, et surfaces API et CLI orientées vers l'utilisateur.

• Leadership qui reste dans le code. Gestion des personnes à travers les fuseaux horaires, examen croisé, décisions d'architecture écrites avec des solutions de rechange enregistrées, et la capacité de dire à un partenaire ou à un cadre supérieur non avec des raisons.

• Excellent écrit et parlé anglais. La plupart des travaux de partenariat et de leadership se font par écrit.

• Lieu . Entièrement distant, basé entre UTC et UTC+5:30 donc la journée de travail chevauche à la fois l'Europe et l'Inde, où l'équipe et ses partenaires travaillent. Voyage occasionnel vers des sites partenaires et des événements d'équipe.

Désireux

• Opérateurs de boues sur Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) ou les planificateurs autochtones Kubernetes (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Piles de service modernes (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): stratégies de parallélisme, compromis de quantisation, planification de mémoire GPU.

• Isolation des VM et des contenants pour le calcul GPU à plusieurs locataires (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU et KVM, Firecracker); calcul confidentiel (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, mode de calcul confidentiel NVIDIA).

• Cluster API et kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure comme code et GitOps.

• Temps du côté opérateur d'un nuage GPU, d'un centre HPC national ou universitaire, ou d'une équipe de plate-forme de laboratoire d'IA.

• Contexte des systèmes de pair à pair ou distribués.

• Expérience avec un fournisseur de matériel qui fournit mais ne fonctionne pas, et transformer cette relation en un contrat écrit avec des tests d'acceptation.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

• Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

• Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

• Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

• Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

• Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

• Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

• Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

• Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

• Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

• Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

• Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

• Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

• Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

• Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

• Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

• Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

• Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

• Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

• Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

• Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Shall we mention that nice to have is the person needs to speak at least 3 languages (more as a marker of flexibility than anything else)

Business Development & Partnerships

• Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

• Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

• Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

• Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

• Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

• Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

• Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

• Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

• Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

• Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

• Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

• Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

• Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

• Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

• Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

• Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

• Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

• Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

• Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

• Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.

We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

Responsibilities

• Request Intake & Triage

• Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.

• Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.

• Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked.

Design Collaboration & Project Management

• Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

• Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.

• Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.

Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

• Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).

• Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).

• Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

• Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

• Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

Risk & Logistics Ownership

• Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.

• Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.

• Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.

Cross-Team Partnership

• Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines.

• Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event.

• 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component.

• Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross-functional requests with competing deadlines.

• Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships.

• Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself.

• A proactive, risk-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable managing stakeholders across different teams with different priorities.

• Familiarity with project management tools (Asana, Monday, or similar) and design review tools like Figma

• Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams.

• Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.

We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

Responsibilities

• Request Intake & Triage

• Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.

• Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.

• Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked.

Design Collaboration & Project Management

• Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

• Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.

• Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.

Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

• Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).

• Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).

• Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

• Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

• Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

Risk & Logistics Ownership

• Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.

• Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.

• Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.

Cross-Team Partnership

• Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines.

• Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event.

• 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component.

• Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross-functional requests with competing deadlines.

• Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships.

• Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself.

• A proactive, risk-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable managing stakeholders across different teams with different priorities.

• Familiarity with project management tools (Asana, Monday, or similar) and design review tools like Figma

• Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams.

• Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
