About the job
 As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.
 We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

• Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

• Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

• Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

• Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

• Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.
We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

• Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

• Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

• Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

• Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

• Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 We are seeking an exceptional VP of Tech Expansion to lead the global adoption and commercial expansion of Tether’s technology ecosystem.
 Reporting directly to the Chief Expansion Officer, this executive will oversee the expansion of current and future technologies across areas such as artificial intelligence, self-custodial infrastructure, peer-to-peer systems, and digital & financial infrastructure.
 The VP will lead several senior professionals globally and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technology verticals, ensuring a coordinated global strategy and compelling propositions for major companies, institutions, and governments.
 The VP will own the talent agenda for international expansion: recruiting, developing and motivating team members, and deepening the existing bench of global leaders across verticals.
 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role requiring strong technology understanding, commercial judgment, executive presence, and global relationship-building capabilities. The ideal candidate can engage with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders, translate complex needs into technology solutions, and convert opportunities into major partnerships and deployments.
 Equally important, the VP will turn these engagements into replicable, scalable products and playbooks, so that each deployment strengthens Tether's ability to enter the next market rather than remaining a one-off.
 International travel is required.

Responsibilities
 Global Strategy & Business Development

• Define and execute the global expansion strategy for Tether’s technology ecosystem.

• Establish priorities across current and future technology verticals.

• Identify high-potential markets, industries, partners, and use cases.

• Build relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, government leaders, and other senior stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close major partnerships and deployments.

• Position Tether as a long-term technology and infrastructure partner.

Solutions & Execution

• Connect Tether’s different capabilities to develop tailored and integrated solutions.

• Translate market and partner requirements into clear opportunities for product and engineering teams.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders and external implementation partners from initial concept through deployment and scale.

• Ensure major projects are delivered on time, within budget, and against measurable objectives.

• Monitor solutionss performance, identify risks, and develop mitigation plans.

Leadership

• Lead the senior professionals and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technologies.

• Set clear priorities, KPIs, and accountability / monitoring frameworks.

• Build a high-performing global Tech Expansion organization.

• Ensure effective collaboration with regional Expansion, product, engineering, legal, and regulatory teams.

• Develop repeatable commercial and execution playbooks across technologies and markets.

• Identify issues requiring escalation and bring them to the Chief Expansion Officer with clear context and recommended options.

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a global leader in decentralized AI, resilient financial infrastructures, and user-centred technologies.

• Represent Tether in strategic engagements with major enterprises, institutions, governments, regulators, and industry leaders.

• Act as a senior ambassador for Tether’s technology vision at global conferences, industry forums and in front of global companies senior executives

• 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, AI, digital infrastructure, fintech and digital assets, telecommunications, or technology business development, including senior leadership experience.

• Strong understanding of emerging technologies, decentralized infrastructure, and digital platforms.

• Proven experience originating, structuring, and closing major enterprise or government technology partnerships.

• Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, government leaders, and other senior decision-makers.

• Experience developing global go-to-market strategies across multiple technologies and markets. Strong leadership experience, including managing senior professionals and international teams.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to coordinate commercial, product, engineering, legal, regulatory, and implementation teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments.

• Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, AI, or a related field, combining strong business expertise with a solid technology foundation; MBA preferred.

• Experience working across multiple regions and cultures.

• An established global network across major enterprises, technology companies, financial institutions, and governments.

Nice to Have: Professional proficiency in three or more languages.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Stiamo cercando un VP eccezionale di Tech Expansion per guidare l'adozione globale e l'espansione commerciale dell'ecosistema tecnologico di Tether.
Segnalandosi direttamente al Chief Expansion Officer, questo esecutivo sovrintenderà all'espansione delle tecnologie attuali e future in settori come l'intelligenza artificiale, l'infrastruttura self-custodial, i sistemi peer-to-peer e le infrastrutture finanziarie e digitali.
Il VP porterà diversi professionisti senior a livello globale e team responsabili dell’espansione delle diverse verticali tecnologiche di Tether, garantendo una strategia globale coordinata e proposizioni convincenti per le principali aziende, istituzioni e governi.
Il VP possiederà l'agenda del talento per l'espansione internazionale: reclutare, sviluppare e motivare i membri del team, e approfondire la panca esistente dei leader globali attraverso i verticali.
Questo è un ruolo di leadership senior, hands-on che richiede una forte comprensione della tecnologia, giudizio commerciale, presenza esecutiva e capacità di costruzione di relazioni globali. Il candidato ideale può impegnarsi con CEO, CTO, CIO e leader governativi, tradurre esigenze complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche e convertire le opportunità in partnership e implementazioni principali.
Allo stesso modo importante, il VP trasformerà questi impegni in prodotti replicabili, scalabili e playbook, in modo che ogni distribuzione rafforza La capacità di Tether di entrare nel prossimo mercato piuttosto che rimanere una tantum.
Il viaggio internazionale è richiesto.

responsabilità
Strategia globale e sviluppo aziendale

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di espansione globale per l’ecosistema tecnologico di Tether.

• Stabilire priorità in verticale della tecnologia attuale e futura.

• Identificare mercati ad alto potenziale, industrie, partner e casi di utilizzo.

• Costruire relazioni con CEO, CTO, CIO, leader governativi e altri stakeholder senior.

• Personalmente originano, struttura, negoziano e chiudono grandi partenariati e distribuzioni.

• Posiziona Tether come partner di tecnologia e infrastrutture a lungo termine.

Soluzioni ed esecuzione

• Collegare le diverse capacità di Tether per sviluppare soluzioni personalizzate e integrate.

• Tradurre i requisiti di mercato e partner in chiare opportunità per i team di prodotto e di ingegneria.

• Coordinare gli stakeholder interni e i partner di implementazione esterni dal concetto iniziale attraverso la distribuzione e la scala.

• Assicurarsi che i grandi progetti vengano consegnati in tempo, entro il bilancio e contro obiettivi misurabili.

• Monitorare le soluzioni performance, identificare i rischi e sviluppare piani di mitigazione.

Leadership

• Guida i professionisti e i team senior responsabili dell’espansione delle diverse tecnologie di Tether.

• Impostare priorità chiare, KPI, e criteri di responsabilità / monitoraggio.

• Costruire un'organizzazione globale di Espansione Tech ad alto rendimento.

• Assicurare una collaborazione efficace con i team regionali di espansione, prodotto, ingegneria, legale e regolamentare.

• Sviluppare cartelle commerciali e di esecuzione ripetibili attraverso tecnologie e mercati.

• Identificare i problemi che richiedono l'escalation e portarli al Chief Expansion Officer con un contesto chiaro e opzioni raccomandate.

Rappresentanza strategica

• Posiziona Tether come leader globale nell'intelligenza artificiale decentralizzata, nelle infrastrutture finanziarie resilienti e nelle tecnologie centrate sull'utente.

• Rappresentare Tether in impegni strategici con grandi imprese, istituzioni, governi, regolatori e leader del settore.

• Atto come ambasciatore senior per la visione tecnologica di Tether a conferenze globali, forum di settore e di fronte a società globali dirigenti senior

• 12+ anni di esperienza in tecnologia aziendale, AI, infrastrutture digitali, fintech e asset digitali, telecomunicazioni o sviluppo di business della tecnologia, tra cui l'esperienza di leadership senior.

• Forte comprensione delle tecnologie emergenti, delle infrastrutture decentrate e delle piattaforme digitali.

• Esperienza comprovata che originano, strutturano e chiudono i principali partenariati aziendali o tecnologici governativi.

• Capacità di impegnarsi credibilmente con dirigenti C-suite, leader governativi e altri decisori senior.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di strategie globali di go-to-market attraverso tecnologie e mercati multipli. Forte esperienza di leadership, tra cui la gestione di professionisti senior e team internazionali.

• Comunicazione eccezionale, negoziazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

• Capacità di coordinare i team commerciali, prodotti, ingegneria, legale, normativo e implementazione.

• Mindset Entrepreneurial e la capacità di operare efficacemente in ambienti in rapida evoluzione.

• Laurea in Business, Ingegneria, Informatica, AI, o un campo correlato, combinando una forte esperienza aziendale con una solida base tecnologica; MBA ha preferito.

• Esperienza di lavoro in più regioni e culture.

• Una rete globale consolidata tra grandi imprese, aziende tecnologiche, istituzioni finanziarie e governi.

Nizza ad avere: competenza professionale in tre o più lingue.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are seeking an exceptional VP of Tech Expansion to lead the global adoption and commercial expansion of Tether’s technology ecosystem.
Reporting directly to the Chief Expansion Officer, this executive will oversee the expansion of current and future technologies across areas such as artificial intelligence, self-custodial infrastructure, peer-to-peer systems, and digital & financial infrastructure.
The VP will lead several senior professionals globally and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technology verticals, ensuring a coordinated global strategy and compelling propositions for major companies, institutions, and governments.
The VP will own the talent agenda for international expansion: recruiting, developing and motivating team members, and deepening the existing bench of global leaders across verticals.
This is a senior, hands-on leadership role requiring strong technology understanding, commercial judgment, executive presence, and global relationship-building capabilities. The ideal candidate can engage with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders, translate complex needs into technology solutions, and convert opportunities into major partnerships and deployments.
Equally important, the VP will turn these engagements into replicable, scalable products and playbooks, so that each deployment strengthens Tether's ability to enter the next market rather than remaining a one-off.
International travel is required.

Responsibilities
Global Strategy & Business Development

• Define and execute the global expansion strategy for Tether’s technology ecosystem.

• Establish priorities across current and future technology verticals.

• Identify high-potential markets, industries, partners, and use cases.

• Build relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, government leaders, and other senior stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close major partnerships and deployments.

• Position Tether as a long-term technology and infrastructure partner.

Solutions & Execution

• Connect Tether’s different capabilities to develop tailored and integrated solutions.

• Translate market and partner requirements into clear opportunities for product and engineering teams.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders and external implementation partners from initial concept through deployment and scale.

• Ensure major projects are delivered on time, within budget, and against measurable objectives.

• Monitor solutionss performance, identify risks, and develop mitigation plans.

Leadership

• Lead the senior professionals and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technologies.

• Set clear priorities, KPIs, and accountability / monitoring frameworks.

• Build a high-performing global Tech Expansion organization.

• Ensure effective collaboration with regional Expansion, product, engineering, legal, and regulatory teams.

• Develop repeatable commercial and execution playbooks across technologies and markets.

• Identify issues requiring escalation and bring them to the Chief Expansion Officer with clear context and recommended options.

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a global leader in decentralized AI, resilient financial infrastructures, and user-centred technologies.

• Represent Tether in strategic engagements with major enterprises, institutions, governments, regulators, and industry leaders.

• Act as a senior ambassador for Tether’s technology vision at global conferences, industry forums and in front of global companies senior executives

• 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, AI, digital infrastructure, fintech and digital assets, telecommunications, or technology business development, including senior leadership experience.

• Strong understanding of emerging technologies, decentralized infrastructure, and digital platforms.

• Proven experience originating, structuring, and closing major enterprise or government technology partnerships.

• Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, government leaders, and other senior decision-makers.

• Experience developing global go-to-market strategies across multiple technologies and markets. Strong leadership experience, including managing senior professionals and international teams.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to coordinate commercial, product, engineering, legal, regulatory, and implementation teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments.

• Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, AI, or a related field, combining strong business expertise with a solid technology foundation; MBA preferred.

• Experience working across multiple regions and cultures.

• An established global network across major enterprises, technology companies, financial institutions, and governments.

Nice to Have: Professional proficiency in three or more languages.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen
Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere innovativen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten -, reservegestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie können Sie digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten speichern, senden und empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet das Vertrauen in jede Transaktion.

Innovation mit Tether
Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite verfügt über den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte von Millionen weltweit verlassen, neben bahnbrechenden Tokenisierungsdiensten für digitale Vermögenswerte.
Aber das ist erst der Anfang:
Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus der Ferne aus allen Ecken der Welt arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlichen VP of Tech Expansion, um die globale Einführung und kommerzielle Expansion des Technologie-Ökosystems von Tether zu leiten.
Diese Führungskraft, die direkt an den Chief Expansion Officer berichtet, wird den Ausbau aktueller und zukünftiger Technologien in Bereichen wie künstlicher Intelligenz, selbstverwahrender Infrastruktur, Peer-to-Peer-Systemen sowie digitaler und finanzieller Infrastruktur überwachen.
Der VP wird mehrere leitende Fachleute weltweit und Teams leiten, die für den Ausbau der verschiedenen Technologievertikalen von Tether verantwortlich sind, um eine koordinierte globale Strategie und überzeugende Vorschläge für große Unternehmen, Institutionen und Regierungen zu gewährleisten.
Der VP wird die Talent-Agenda für die internationale Expansion besitzen: Rekrutierung, Entwicklung und Motivation von Teammitgliedern und Vertiefung der bestehenden Bank von globalen Führungskräften in allen Branchen.
Dies ist eine leitende, praktische Führungsrolle, die ein starkes Technologieverständnis, wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen, Führungspräsenz und globale Fähigkeiten zum Aufbau von Beziehungen erfordert. Der ideale Kandidat kann mit CEOs, CTOs, CIOs und Regierungsführern zusammenarbeiten, komplexe Anforderungen in Technologielösungen umsetzen und Chancen in wichtige Partnerschaften und Implementierungen umwandeln.
Ebenso wichtig ist, dass der VP diese Engagements in replizierbare, skalierbare Produkte und Playbooks umwandelt, so dass jeder Einsatz gestärkt wird. Die Fähigkeit von Tether, in den nächsten Markt einzusteigen, anstatt ein einmaliges Geschäft zu bleiben.
Internationale Reisen sind erforderlich.

Zuständigkeiten
Globale Strategie und Geschäftsentwicklung

• Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Expansionsstrategie für das Technologie-Ökosystem von Tether.

• Legen Sie Prioritäten für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologievertikalen fest.

• Identifizieren Sie potenzielle Märkte, Branchen, Partner und Anwendungsfälle.

• Aufbau von Beziehungen zu CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, Regierungsführern und anderen hochrangigen Stakeholdern.

• Persönlich erstellen, strukturieren, verhandeln und schließen wichtige Partnerschaften und Bereitstellungen.

• Positionieren Sie Tether als langfristigen Technologie- und Infrastrukturpartner.

Lösungen & Ausführung

• Verbinden Sie die verschiedenen Fähigkeiten von Tether, um maßgeschneiderte und integrierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.

• Übersetzen Sie Markt- und Partneranforderungen in klare Möglichkeiten für Produkt- und Engineering-Teams.

• Koordinieren Sie interne Stakeholder und externe Implementierungspartner vom ersten Konzept bis hin zum Deployment und zur Skalierung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Großprojekte pünktlich, im Rahmen des Budgets und mit messbaren Zielen durchgeführt werden.

• Überwachen Sie die Leistung von Lösungen, identifizieren Sie Risiken und entwickeln Sie Minderungspläne.

Führung

• Führen Sie die leitenden Fachleute und Teams, die für die Erweiterung der verschiedenen Technologien von Tether verantwortlich sind.

• Legen Sie klare Prioritäten, KPIs und Rechenschaftspflicht / Überwachungsrahmen fest.

• Aufbau einer leistungsstarken globalen Tech Expansion Organisation.

• Gewährleistung einer effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Expansions-, Produkt-, Engineering-, Rechts- und Regulierungsteams.

• Entwickeln Sie wiederholbare kommerzielle und ausführende Playbooks für alle Technologien und Märkte.

• Identifizieren Sie Fragen, die eine Eskalation erfordern, und bringen Sie sie dem Chief Expansion Officer mit klarem Kontext und empfohlenen Optionen.

Strategische Vertretung

• Positionieren Sie Tether als globalen Marktführer für dezentrale KI, resiliente Finanzinfrastrukturen und nutzerzentrierte Technologien.

• Repräsentieren Sie Tether in strategischen Engagements mit großen Unternehmen, Institutionen, Regierungen, Regulierungsbehörden und Branchenführern.

• Handeln Sie als Senior Ambassador für die Technologievision von Tether auf globalen Konferenzen, Branchenforen und vor Führungskräften globaler Unternehmen

• 12+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Unternehmenstechnologie, KI, digitale Infrastruktur, Fintech und digitale Assets, Telekommunikation oder Technologieentwicklung, einschließlich Führungserfahrung.

• Starkes Verständnis für neue Technologien, dezentrale Infrastruktur und digitale Plattformen.

• Bewährte Erfahrung bei der Entstehung, Strukturierung und Schließung großer Technologiepartnerschaften für Unternehmen oder Behörden.

• Fähigkeit, sich glaubwürdig mit Führungskräften der C-Suite, Regierungsführern und anderen hochrangigen Entscheidungsträgern auseinanderzusetzen.

• Erleben Sie die Entwicklung globaler Go-to-Market-Strategien für verschiedene Technologien und Märkte. Starke Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Management von Senior Professionals und internationalen Teams.

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation, Verhandlung und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, kommerzielle, Produkt-, Engineering-, Rechts-, Regulierungs- und Implementierungsteams zu koordinieren.

• Unternehmerische Denkweise und Fähigkeit, in schnelllebigen Umgebungen effektiv zu arbeiten.

• Abschluss in Business, Engineering, Informatik, KI oder einem verwandten Bereich, der starke Geschäftsexpertise mit einer soliden Technologiebasis kombiniert; MBA bevorzugt.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in verschiedenen Regionen und Kulturen.

• Ein etabliertes globales Netzwerk zwischen großen Unternehmen, Technologieunternehmen, Finanzinstituten und Regierungen.

Nice to Have: Professionelle Kenntnisse in drei oder mehr Sprachen.

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Im zweifelsfall, fühlen sie sich frei, über unsere offizielle website zu erreichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Nous recherchons un VP exceptionnel d'expansion technologique pour mener l'adoption mondiale et l'expansion commerciale de l'écosystème technologique de Tether.
Relevant directement du dirigeant principal de l'expansion, ce dirigeant supervisera l'expansion des technologies actuelles et futures dans des domaines comme l'intelligence artificielle, l'infrastructure auto-détenue, les systèmes de pair à pair et l'infrastructure numérique et financière.
Le vice-président dirigera plusieurs professionnels de haut niveau à l'échelle mondiale et des équipes chargées d'élargir les différentes verticales technologiques de Tether, assurant ainsi une stratégie globale coordonnée et des propositions convaincantes pour les grandes entreprises, les institutions et les gouvernements.
Le vice-président sera propriétaire du programme de talents pour l'expansion internationale : recrutement, développement et motivation des membres de l'équipe, et approfondissement du banc existant de leaders mondiaux à travers les verticales.
Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership principal et pratique qui exige une solide compréhension de la technologie, un jugement commercial, une présence de l'exécutif et des capacités d'établissement de relations mondiales. Le candidat idéal peut s'engager avec les PDG, les OCT, les OIC et les dirigeants gouvernementaux, traduire les besoins complexes en solutions technologiques et transformer les possibilités en partenariats et en déploiements majeurs.
Tout aussi important, le vice-président transformera ces engagements en produits reproductibles et évolutifs et en livres de lecture, afin que chaque déploiement renforce La capacité de Tether d'entrer sur le marché suivant plutôt que de rester un marché unique.
Un voyage international est nécessaire.

Responsabilités
Stratégie mondiale et développement des entreprises

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie globale d'expansion pour l'écosystème technologique de Tether.

• Établir des priorités pour les verticales technologiques actuelles et futures.

• Identifier les marchés, les industries, les partenaires et les cas d'utilisation à fort potentiel.

• Établir des relations avec les PDG, les CTO, les CIO, les dirigeants gouvernementaux et d'autres intervenants de haut niveau.

• Personnellement, ils sont à l'origine, structurent, négocient et ferment des partenariats et des déploiements importants.

• Positionner Tether en tant que partenaire technologique et infrastructure à long terme.

Solutions et exécution

• Connect Tether® offre différentes capacités pour développer des solutions adaptées et intégrées.

• Traduire les exigences du marché et des partenaires en opportunités claires pour les équipes de produits et d'ingénierie.

• Coordonner les intervenants internes et les partenaires externes de la mise en oeuvre, du concept initial au déploiement et à l'échelle.

• Veiller à ce que les grands projets soient exécutés à temps, dans les limites du budget et par rapport à des objectifs mesurables.

• Surveiller le rendement des solutions, cerner les risques et élaborer des plans d'atténuation.

Leadership

• Dirigez les professionnels et les équipes seniors responsables de l'expansion des différentes technologies de Tether.

• Établir des priorités claires, des ICR et des cadres de responsabilisation et de suivi.

• Créer une organisation mondiale d'expansion technologique performante.

• Assurer une collaboration efficace avec les équipes régionales d'expansion, de produits, d'ingénierie, de droit et de réglementation.

• Mettre au point des livres de lecture commerciaux et d'exécution reproductibles à travers les technologies et les marchés.

• Déterminer les problèmes qui nécessitent une escalade et les présenter au dirigeant principal de l'expansion dans un contexte clair et les options recommandées.

Représentation stratégique

• Positionnez Tether comme un leader mondial dans l'IA décentralisée, les infrastructures financières résilientes et les technologies centrées sur les utilisateurs.

• Représenter Tether dans les engagements stratégiques avec les grandes entreprises, les institutions, les gouvernements, les organismes de réglementation et les dirigeants de l'industrie.

• Agir en tant qu'ambassadeur principal pour la vision technologique de Tethers lors de conférences mondiales, de forums industriels et devant des dirigeants d'entreprises mondiales

• 12 ans et plus d'expérience dans les domaines de la technologie d'entreprise, de l'IA, de l'infrastructure numérique, de la fintech et des actifs numériques, des télécommunications ou du développement d'entreprises technologiques, y compris l'expérience en leadership.

• Une bonne compréhension des technologies émergentes, des infrastructures décentralisées et des plateformes numériques.

• Expérience éprouvée à l'origine, à la structuration et à la fermeture de grands partenariats technologiques d'entreprise ou de gouvernement.

• Capacité de s'engager de façon crédible auprès des cadres supérieurs de la C-suite, des dirigeants gouvernementaux et d'autres décideurs supérieurs.

• Expérience de l'élaboration de stratégies mondiales de mise en marché à travers plusieurs technologies et marchés. Forte expérience de leadership, y compris la gestion de cadres supérieurs et d'équipes internationales.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication, négociation et gestion des parties prenantes.

• Capacité de coordonner les équipes commerciales, de produits, d'ingénierie, juridiques, réglementaires et de mise en oeuvre.

• L'esprit d'entreprise et la capacité à fonctionner efficacement dans des environnements en mouvement rapide.

• Diplôme en affaires, en génie, en informatique, en intelligence artificielle ou dans un domaine connexe, combinant une solide expertise commerciale avec une solide base technologique; MBA préféré.

• Expérience de travail dans plusieurs régions et cultures.

• Un réseau mondial établi entre les grandes entreprises, les entreprises technologiques, les institutions financières et les gouvernements.

Bon à avoir: Compétence professionnelle en trois langues ou plus.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

jobs.description:
The role:
 Tether Capital is launching a new credit vertical focused on providing short-term liquidity and credit facilities to fintech companies, payment providers, exchanges, and other financial institutions.

We are looking for a Credit Lead (underwriter) focused on institutional lending and liquidity to join this new initiative and help build the credit function from the ground up.
 This is a hands-on role for someone with strong experience in credit underwriting and structuring, who is comfortable assessing businesses, making credit recommendations, and developing the policies and processes needed to support a growing lending platform.

Key Responsibilities:

• Underwrite and structure credit facilities, including revolving credit facilities, working capital loans, and liquidity facilities.

• Analyse companies' financial statements, cash flows, liquidity position and repayment capacity.

• Determine appropriate lending amounts, terms, covenants, security, and other risk protections.

• Develop credit policies, underwriting guidelines, templates, and concentration limits from scratch.

• Monitor credit risk and borrower performance and establish appropriate risk-monitoring processes.

• Support the development and scaling of the new credit business.

Requirements:

• 10+ years of relevant credit experience.

• Strong experience in credit underwriting and structuring , rather than purely credit analysis.

• Previous experience with fintech & payments is mandatory.

• Background in institutional lending, private credit, venture debt, specialty finance, or a similar environment.

• Experience establishing or developing credit policies, processes, or risk frameworks.

• Crypto, digital assets, or stablecoin experience is a plus, but not required .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il ruolo:
Tether Capital lancia un nuovo credito verticale focalizzato sulla fornitura di liquidità a breve termine e strutture di credito a imprese fintech, fornitori di pagamento, scambi e altre istituzioni finanziarie.

Stiamo cercando un Credit Lead (sottoscrittore) focalizzato sui prestiti istituzionali e la liquidità per unire questa nuova iniziativa e contribuire a costruire la funzione di credito da zero.
Questo è un ruolo pratico per qualcuno con una forte esperienza nella sottoscrizione e nella strutturazione del credito, che è comodo valutare le aziende, fare raccomandazioni di credito, e lo sviluppo delle politiche e dei processi necessari per sostenere una crescente piattaforma di prestito.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Sottoscrittura e strutture di credito, tra cui strutture di credito revolving, prestiti di capitale di lavoro e impianti di liquidità.

• Analizzare il bilancio delle società, i flussi di cassa, la posizione di liquidità e la capacità di rimborso.

• Determinare gli importi, i termini, i patti, la sicurezza e altre protezioni dei rischi.

• Sviluppare politiche di credito, sottoscrivere linee guida, modelli e limiti di concentrazione da zero.

• Monitorare il rischio di credito e le prestazioni del mutuatario e stabilire processi di monitoraggio del rischio appropriati.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo e lo scaling della nuova attività di credito.

Requisiti:

• 10+ anni di esperienza di credito rilevante.

• Una forte esperienza nella scrittura e nella strutturazione del credito, piuttosto che nell'analisi puramente del credito.

• L'esperienza precedente con fintech & pagamenti è obbligatoria.

• Sfondo di prestiti istituzionali, credito privato, debito di rischio, finanza di specialità, o un ambiente simile.

• Prova a stabilire o sviluppare politiche di credito, processi o framework di rischio.

• Crypto, beni digitali, o stablecoin esperienza è un plus, ma non richiesto.

Die Rolle:
Tether Capital startet eine neue Kreditvertikale, die sich auf die Bereitstellung kurzfristiger Liquidität und Kreditfazilitäten für Fintech-Unternehmen, Zahlungsanbieter, Börsen und andere Finanzinstitute konzentriert.

Wir suchen einen Credit Lead (Underwriter), der sich auf institutionelle Kreditvergabe und Liquidität konzentriert, um dieser neuen Initiative beizutreten und die Kreditfunktion von Grund auf aufzubauen.
Dies ist eine praktische Rolle für jemanden mit starker Erfahrung in der Kreditvergabe und -strukturierung, der es sich bequem macht, Unternehmen zu bewerten, Kreditempfehlungen abzugeben und die Richtlinien und Prozesse zu entwickeln, die zur Unterstützung einer wachsenden Kreditplattform erforderlich sind.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Kreditfazilitäten, einschließlich revolvierender Kreditfazilitäten, Betriebsmitteldarlehen und Liquiditätsfazilitäten, sind zu zeichnen und zu strukturieren.

• Analyse der Unternehmensabschlüsse, Cashflows, Liquiditätslage und Rückzahlungskapazität.

• Bestimmen Sie angemessene Kreditbeträge, Bedingungen, Covenants, Sicherheiten und andere Risikoschutzmaßnahmen.

• Entwickeln Sie Kreditrichtlinien, Zeichnungsrichtlinien, Vorlagen und Konzentrationsgrenzen von Grund auf neu.

• Überwachung des Kreditrisikos und der Leistung des Kreditnehmers und Festlegung geeigneter Risikoüberwachungsprozesse.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Skalierung des neuen Kreditgeschäfts.

Anforderungen:

• 10+ Jahre einschlägige Krediterfahrung.

• Starke Erfahrung in Credit Underwriting und Strukturierung, anstatt rein Kredit-Analyse.

• Frühere Erfahrungen mit Fintech & Payments sind obligatorisch.

• Hintergrund in institutionellen Krediten, Privatkrediten, Venture Debt, Spezialfinanzierungen oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in der Einrichtung oder Entwicklung von Kreditrichtlinien, -prozessen oder Risikorahmen.

• Crypto, digitale Assets oder Stablecoin-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

Rôle :
Tether Capital lance une nouvelle verticale de crédit axée sur la fourniture de liquidités et de facilités de crédit à court terme aux sociétés fintech, aux fournisseurs de paiement, aux bourses et aux autres institutions financières.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable du crédit (sous-traitant) axé sur les prêts institutionnels et la liquidité pour rejoindre cette nouvelle initiative et aider à construire la fonction de crédit à partir de la base.
Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique pour quelqu'un qui a une solide expérience de la souscription et de la structuration du crédit, qui est à l'aise d'évaluer les entreprises, de formuler des recommandations en matière de crédit et d'élaborer les politiques et les processus nécessaires pour soutenir une plateforme de prêt croissante.

Principales responsabilités :

• Placer et structurer les facilités de crédit, y compris les facilités de crédit renouvelables, les prêts de fonds de roulement et les facilités de liquidité.

• Analyser les états financiers, les flux de trésorerie, la position de liquidité et la capacité de remboursement des entreprises.

• Déterminer les montants de prêt, les modalités, les clauses, les garanties et les autres mesures de protection du risque appropriées.

• Élaborer des politiques de crédit, souscrire des lignes directrices, des modèles et des limites de concentration à partir de zéro.

• Surveiller le risque de crédit et le rendement de l'emprunteur et établir des processus appropriés de surveillance du risque.

• Appuyer le développement et l'expansion de la nouvelle entreprise de crédit.

• Forte expérience de la souscription et de la structuration du crédit , plutôt que de l'analyse purement de crédit.
